d:
Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: bihariyon ke bare men ek kahavat mashhur hai... bihari jahan jate hain, apni pahchan chhor aate hain... aur jab bat mehmananvaji ki ho, to dil kholkar svagat karte hain... lekin is bar bihar ki mehmananvaji ki charcha sirph desh men nahin balki videshon tak pahunch gaee hai... BBC, The Guardian se lekar Al Jazeera tak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ki charcha kar rahe hain... aakhir is shadi men aisa kya huaa ki puri duniya ki najren bihar ke ek chhote se ganv par tik gaeen...
